name: minimax-vscode-copilot
description: Language model provider for GitHub Copilot in VS Code: use MiniMax M2.7 / M2.7-highspeed / M3 models for programming with a Token Plan API key over the Anthropic-compatible API. Does not add speech, video, or image generation APIs.

minimax.apiBaseUrl.markdownDescription: MiniMax Anthropic-compatible API base URL. Use `https://api.minimaxi.com/anthropic` for users in China, or `https://api.minimax.io/anthropic` for international users. The Anthropic SDK appends `/v1/messages` automatically.

minimax.apiKey.markdownDescription: Fallback MiniMax API key when SecretStorage is unavailable (e.g. CI/automation). Prefer the in-product API key navigation action, which stores the key in SecretStorage.

minimax.visibleModels.markdownDescription: Programming text models (M2.7 / M2.7-highspeed / M3) for Token Plan. M3 is the latest native-multimodal frontier coding model (officially 1M context; effective 512K until the >512K tier is fully rolled out). MiniMax no longer recommends M2.5 and earlier.

minimax.commitModel.markdownDescription: Model used by **MiniMax: Generate Commit Message**. Defaults to `MiniMax-M3` — M3 and M2.7 now share the same per-token price (input ¥2.10/M, output ¥8.40/M on the China endpoint), so M3's frontier-coding quality is the obvious choice. Switch to `MiniMax-M2.7-highspeed` if you want a faster draft.

minimax.maxTokens.markdownDescription: Maximum number of output tokens. `0` (default) lets the model decide; the upstream API is responsible for any per-model ceiling. Set a positive integer to cap the output yourself; the value is sent verbatim and any 4xx from the upstream is surfaced as-is.

minimax.enableM31MContext.markdownDescription: Lift the **MiniMax-M3** context window advertised in the model picker from the safe default of 512,000 to the official 1,000,000-token cap. **Off by default.** Enabling this unlocks the >512K input tier only if your MiniMax account has been granted access; otherwise the upstream API will return HTTP 400 for requests above 512K, and the >512K tier is billed at **2× the per-token rate** of the standard tier (see the [pricing page](https://platform.minimaxi.com/docs/guides/pricing-paygo)). Prefer the **MiniMax: Toggle M3 1M Context** command — it surfaces the warnings inline before flipping the switch.

minimax.thinking.enabled.markdownDescription: Toggle the typed `thinking` content block for **MiniMax-M3**. When `true` (default), M3 emits its reasoning trace as a `thinking` block; when `false`, the API returns the answer without a typed thinking trace. The Anthropic constraint that `temperature=1` and `top_p` is dropped only applies while thinking is on, so flipping this off also unlocks your custom `temperature` / `topP` from `minimax.sampling`. M2.x always stays on — the docs say `disabled` is a no-op for the M2 family, so this setting is ignored for M2.7 / M2.7-highspeed. Use the **MiniMax: Toggle M3 Thinking Mode** command for a one-click flip.

minimax.debugMode.markdownDescription: Diagnostic verbosity. `verbose` writes full request payloads to `<globalStorage>/request-dumps/<segmentId>/` for debugging.

minimax.modelIdOverrides.markdownDescription: Override the API model ID for each picker model ID. Useful when routing through a third-party proxy that uses different model names.

minimax.visionModel.markdownDescription: Language model chat ID used to describe image attachments for non-multimodal MiniMax models. Leave empty to auto-detect. Has no effect on `MiniMax-M3` which receives images directly.

minimax.visionPrompt.default:
Describe all image attachments in this message.

If there is one image, describe it directly.
If there are multiple images:
1. Describe each image separately, preserving their order.
2. Then provide a combined description explaining the overall context and relationships across the images.

Return one concise factual description suitable for inserting into a text-only chat prompt. Include visible text, objects, UI elements, people, and relevant context. Do not invent details.
minimax.visionPrompt.markdownDescription: Prompt sent to the vision proxy when describing image attachments for non-multimodal MiniMax models.

minimax.experimental.stabilizeToolList.markdownDescription: **Experimental.** When the Copilot host presents placeholder `activate_*` tools, synthesise preflight tool calls so the tool list stays stable across turns. Improves cache hit rate but adds extra round-trips. Restart the chat session after changing.

minimax.sampling.markdownDescription: Per-model sampling overrides. Map a model ID (`MiniMax-M3`, `MiniMax-M2.7`, `MiniMax-M2.7-highspeed`) to a `{ temperature?, topP?, topK?, frequencyPenalty? }` object. Each field is optional; unset fields fall back to the API default. **Ignored when thinking is on** for `temperature` and `topP` (Anthropic's `thinking: { type: 'adaptive' }` constraint forces `temperature: 1` and drops `topP`). Restart the chat session after changing.

temperature.markdownDescription: Overrides `temperature`. `0` is greedy, `2` is most random.

topP.markdownDescription: Overrides `top_p` (nucleus sampling). Ignored when thinking is on.

topK.markdownDescription: Overrides `top_k` (sampling cutoff). Always honoured, including when thinking is on.

frequencyPenalty.markdownDescription: Overrides `frequency_penalty`. Always honoured, including when thinking is on.

minimax.experimental.modelDefPresets.markdownDescription: **Experimental.** Per-model `extra` escape hatch. Map a model ID to an object whose keys are merged verbatim into the Anthropic request body. Reserved keys (`model`, `messages`, `stream`, `max_tokens`, `system`, `thinking`, `tools`, `temperature`, `top_p`, `top_k`, `frequency_penalty`) are ignored. Useful for `stop_sequences`, `service_tier`, or whatever MiniMax adds next.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: MiniMax Token Plan API key. Get it from platform.minimaxi.com (China) or platform.minimax.io (international), under Account / Token Plan.

scripts.package:dev: npm run build && npm run package
